regions.name: Metasprites: 114 records, 53 offset tables
regions.description: $C3A6-$CBDB. 114 metasprite records and 53 (x, y) offset tables, interleaved. A record is [count][offsets lo][offsets hi][tiles][attributes], named by the split pointer table at $C28D (low) and $C319 (high) and drawn by $CC46. Bit 7 of the count means draw the whole thing twice with bit 6 of the attribute flipped - a free mirror image. Tile numbers are RELATIVE, added to the object's own base tile at $87, and $FF skips a sprite. The attribute array is run-length coded: $CE23 advances it only when bit 3 of the byte is clear, which is why a record's length does not follow from its count. Offset tables are shared - 118 metasprites use 57 of them - so records and tables interleave and this region is a contiguous run of covered bytes rather than one record. Generated by tools/parse-metasprites.py; the format is in tools/tgl/metasprite.py.
